Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — the team found the serving economics examples very helpful. We're preparing a short executive-level demo next week and I'd like to confirm VP/CTO attendance if possible. High-level ask: 20–30 minute exec walkthrough (non-technical) followed immediately by a 45 minute technical deep dive for the platform and infra owners.

Who from Redwood would be best for the 20–30 minute sponsor intro? Our goal is to have Michael Torres (VP Product) and their CTO join the sponsor segment; they can drop for the deep dive if their schedule requires it. Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Apr 3, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 4, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Apr 5, 09:00–10:30

Attaching a one-pager org chart so you can see stakeholders. Can you confirm whether a VP-level person is available for the 20–30 minute slot and who will cover the technical deep dive?

Thanks,
Angela

Subject: Re: ApexCloud — exec intro + demo: aligning VP/CTO availability

Hi Angela — great to hear, thanks for sharing the windows and the org chart.

We can support a 20–30 minute sponsor intro from Redwood. Two options from our side:
- Karthik Iyer (VP, Solutions) — best for product + economic framing
- Marissa Cole (Sr. Solutions Lead) — excellent at executive narratives and timeboxed sponsor intros if Karthik is booked

For the technical deep dive, I suggest Karthik + one engineer from infra; if Karthik needs to stay on for the sponsor segment and then transition, Marissa can step in for the sponsor.

All three windows work for Redwood; our preference is Wed Apr 4, 14:00–15:30 PDT because it gives us time to align internal pre-reads. If that works for Michael and the CTO, we'll lock it and I can send a calendar invite (we'll include separate invites for the sponsor intro and the deep dive).

I'll loop Marissa on internal coverage.

Soojin
